defects.evidence: Line 195: "the test asserts that every command in the P1 row has a `## Unattended mode` section". AC-1.1 and the P1 scope are now limited to the P1 row, and each later phase adds its own commands, so P1 no longer asserts P2-P4 or pr-submit.

Line 154: "so no command accepts the flag while its gate still prompts or acts outward". Section 6 ties the flag and section to the phase that converts the command's gates, so no command accepts the flag with an unconverted gate.

Line 112: "none: use it as a step inside another worker's brief, not as its own Task". The P1 row still lists load, AC-1.1 requires every P1-row command to name return-contract.yaml and AC-1.2 live-runs each P1 command, while the load row gives no report and Decisions rejects one. WC-4 now gives a per-file sibling contract name for file-valued --output (tdd, init-lite, spec-panel), consistent with those rows and AC-1.2; two workers cannot share one contract.
